goal: Decide which backend capability serves each front end feature at a connected or an air-gapped site, so every feature the views need is served, and none reaches the network where there is none.

app.name: backend-capability
app.title: Backend capability
app.purpose: Decide, as a DMN decision table with hit policy FIRST, which backend capability serves a front end feature at a site that is online or air-gapped: the verified guest, the static model record, acceptance-vector replay, the fingerprint check, the proof bundled with the site, or a link to the CI attestation.
limits: Every capability runs in the reader's browser or is a static file of the site; there is no application server.
Which feature a view shows is decided by frontend-feature.

fields.name: feature
fields.means: the front end feature to serve, as frontend-feature names it

fields.name: site
fields.means: whether the site serving the page can reach the internet

meanings.guest-dispatch: the verified WebAssembly guest computes the answer in the browser, through the router
meanings.model-record: the static model record the builder writes, site/app.json and the facet modules
meanings.vector-replay: the guest replays the acceptance vectors, so each journey step is a checked answer
meanings.fingerprint-check: the browser recomputes the holo fingerprint and compares it with the published one
meanings.bundled-proof: the LexLean proof sources shipped inside the site, readable with no network
meanings.attestation-link: a link to the CI run that checked the proofs, on GitHub

rules.why: the seal is the fingerprint, recomputed in the browser
the answer is computed by the verified guest, never by a server
journey steps are the acceptance vectors, replayed
the reason is read from the model the guest is built from
the words are read from the product record
the rules and their citations are read from the model
with no network the proof is read from the sources shipped with the site
online, the proof panel links the CI run that checked it

app.otherwiseWhy: anything else is read from the static model record

properties.why: nothing at an air-gapped site ever reaches for the network
the seal is always recomputed, never trusted as text
every answer comes from the verified guest

stakeholders.name: Cloud engineer
stakeholders.text: Runs the same page at a disconnected site and needs every feature to work there with no internet.

stakeholders.name: Security engineer
stakeholders.text: Needs every answer computed by the sealed guest, never by a server that could be changed quietly.

concerns.name: Works with no network
concerns.text: Every front end feature is served at an air-gapped site from the browser and the static site alone.

components.name: Prism page
components.text: The published GitHub Pages site: it checks the holo seal, sends the request to the verified guest in the browser and shows the answer in the reader's view.

components.name: Site mirror
components.text: The air-gapped site's own registry and static host, which serves the page, the holo and the bundled proofs.

quality.text: Every feature is served at an air-gapped site with no network call.
quality.measure: Network calls at an air-gapped site
quality.measureText: Features answered attestation-link when the site is airgapped.

quality.text: Every answer is computed by the verified guest.
quality.measureText: Verdict cards served by anything but guest dispatch.

threats.name: Server-side answer substitution
threats.text: A server between the reader and the decision returns a different answer than the sealed guest would.

control.name: Guest-only answers
control.text: Every verdict card is served by guest dispatch in the browser, proved for every request.
